t: These joint connector bolts are essential fasteners for robust assembly tasks. The M6 x 25mm size is ideal for securely joining components in furniture construction, cabinet making, and various woodworking projects. Each bolt features a bright zinc plated (BZP) finish, providing enhanced corrosion resistance for long-lasting performance. Supplied in a convenient 50-pack, these versatile bolts are suitable for use with cross dowels and T-nuts, ensuring strong and reliable connections across a range of applications.
b: Suitable for Beading, Cabinet & Furniture Work, Secret Nailing & Shop Fitting
